AI Company Anthropic Sued Over Music Copyright

AI company Anthropic is facing a new lawsuit alleging it used copyrighted music to train its AI model, Claude. Sony Music Entertainment claims Anthropic engaged in a "brazen campaign" to use its music without permission. Sony is seeking up to $150,000 per song infringed. The lawsuit was filed by Anthropic, the developer of the AI chatbot Claude.
